scope: One original executor/issuer arbitration domain shared across assemblies; not a database connection or arbitrary driver/native memory guarantee

rules.admission: Reserve lease slot, eventual settlement-record slot and bounded exact record capacity before pool acquisition; apply smaller enclosing host/pool limits. Queued/uncertain acquisitions and quarantined leases consume their retained slots.
rules.records: Count original record bytes and all retained copies; no digest-only replacement, truncation or native error detail projection can establish complete recovery custody.
rules.release: Confirmed clean pool return or confirmed physical termination releases physical lease occupancy only. Retained unknown outcome continues occupying settlement capacity until qualified original resolution and its retention obligations are discharged.
rules.reconstruction: New facade/assembly does not reset original executor limits or transfer unknown custody to another executor.
rules.saturation: Refuse new owned work before pool acquisition; no eviction, guessed expiry, callback retry or recycle of quarantined clients.

qualification: Pin actual adapter/pool/issuer/account/build producers and independent exact/one-over mixed active/quarantined/terminated-unknown schedules; no native qualification supplied.
